document.about: Thermo Scientific M Series centrifuges flyer (2 pages). The cover sets a 12 pt category tag in a red box above the 28 pt title, and the back page closes on a link line.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.
